source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: **Snap Shooting** (15.09) is available only when some other rule grants this type of shooting. The unit shoots following [Making Attacks](vsdata:core-rule/making-attacks) (04), but it may pick just one enemy unit as its target, and that unit must be visible, an eligible target and no more than 24 inches away. Only a Hit roll showing a natural 6 scores a hit, regardless of the weapon's Ballistic Skill or any modifiers; such hits never count as critical hits, and Hit rolls cannot be re-rolled. Once it has shot, the unit cannot start an action for the rest of that phase.
